title: Choose the visual world
question: Whole localhost UI redesign for Local backup. Operate mode: minimum-hassle setup first; trust after backups exist. The roll assigned Field Notebook. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Field Notebook
options.lineage: field notebooks and graph-paper run logs
options.thesis: Your backups live as dated pages on this machine — set up first, then read trust like a margin note.
options.viewport: Local backup shell with Set up a backup as the lead action; empty state teaches files-first local-only; when sites exist, a quiet list expands for restore confidence.
options.risk: Can feel sparse or “notes app” if the setup path isn’t the loudest thing on first open.

raised.raise: Shell names two jobs without burying trust: Set up leads; After a backup, trust is one click away.
Every setup step uses the same frame and scale so the wizard never reshuffles the room.
A site row expands in place to show last run and restore confidence — no extra destination.
Backup progress encodes elapsed duration as a growing block, not a vague spinner.
The list stays quiet; only the open site is fully decoded.

options.label: Household Binder
options.thesis: Each site is a labeled tab in a binder you already keep at home — open the page, do the next thing.
options.viewport: Tabbed shell: Setup / Sites; first open lands on Setup with one primary path; Sites tab surfaces trust after backups exist.
options.risk: Also the familiar direction most product-UI runs land on — Settings-adjacent comfort.

options.label: Split-Flap Status
options.thesis: Last run and restore confidence update like a departure board — one gaze tells you if you’re safe.
options.viewport: Top Set up action; below, site rows as status lines (last run, confidence, next action) with a brief cascade when a run finishes.
options.case: Beats Field Notebook on product clarity for status scanning; loses on audience ID for personal machine records.
options.risk: Can costume the UI as an ops board if flaps own the layout instead of lending type, palette, density, and one update move.

options.label: Cassette J-Card
options.case: Side A / Side B maps setup vs trust cleverly, but backup operators don’t identify with mixtapes.
options.kept: Hard sides for the two jobs — setup leads; trust is the other named half.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.case: Life-stage sequence fits a wizard, but the audience isn’t botanical.
options.kept: Fixed-scale stages — every setup step shares one frame.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.case: Focus expansion is strong for site metadata, but the wall reads entertainment browsing, not minimum-hassle backup.

options.label: Labanotation
options.case: Duration-as-length is clear for progress, but notation fails audience identification for this product.
options.kept: Progress as a growing duration block.

options.label: Factory Catalog
options.kept: Quiet list; one fully decoded active site.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean backup admin: site list, status, setup wizard — executed at full craft, no WordPress-first story, local-only as a complete win.
canonCard.viewport: Home with Set up a backup; site cards with last run and restore confidence.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from generic backup dashboards by design.
